Send GET /api/recordings/{recordingId}/download with Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>.
Repeat as the Secretary.
expected: HTTP 403 Forbidden in both calls.
Body: { "code": "MSG356", "message": "Bản ghi và bản gỡ băng của cuộc họp Mật không được tải về." }.
Listening through /playback still works for the roster.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
An InPerson meeting in Ended with a Chair, a Secretary and a Member on its participant list. The meeting is Secret (Mật).

cases.description: Verify GET /api/meetings/{meetingId}/speech-clips lists the per-microphone sentences of the meeting for a participant.
procedure: Sign in as a Member of the meeting (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
Send GET /api/meetings/{meetingId}/speech-clips with Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>.
expected: HTTP 200 OK.

Body: { "meetingId", "canCapture", "canEdit": false, "canExclude": false, "canExport": false, "retentionDays": 180, "readAt", "items": [ { "id", "speakerId", "speakerName", "startedAt", "durationMs", "text", "canDelete", "excluded", "leak", "hasAudio", "peaks", "speakerIsGuest" } ] } ordered by startedAt.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
An Online meeting in InProgress with a Chair, a Secretary and a Member on its participant list. Sentences from two members.

cases.description: Verify GET /api/meetings/{meetingId}/speech-clips?since= returns only new or changed sentences and those within 2 seconds of them.
procedure: Sign in as a Member of the meeting (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
Send GET /api/meetings/{meetingId}/speech-clips?since=<readAt of the previous read> with Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>.
expected: HTTP 200 OK.
Only sentences new or edited after readAt are returned, plus neighbours within 2 seconds of them.
A read with since set to now returns no sentence but still gives retentionDays.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
An Online meeting in InProgress with a Chair, a Secretary and a Member on its participant list. An earlier read with its readAt.

cases.description: Verify GET /api/meetings/{meetingId}/speech-clips shows an excluded sentence's text only to the Chair and Secretary.
procedure: Sign in as the Chair of the meeting (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
Send GET /api/meetings/{meetingId}/speech-clips with Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>.
Repeat as a Member.
expected: The Chair's items show the text, "excluded": true, "exclusionReason" and "excludedByName".
The Member's item for that sentence has "text": "", "excluded": true and "hasAudio": false.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
An Online meeting in InProgress with a Chair, a Secretary and a Member on its participant list. One sentence excluded from the record.

cases.description: Verify GET /api/meetings/{meetingId}/speech-clips gives the Secretary the editing and export rights and canCapture only for a running remote meeting.
procedure: Sign in as the Secretary of the meeting (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
Send GET /api/meetings/{meetingId}/speech-clips with Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>.
expected: HTTP 200 OK with "canEdit": true, "canExclude": true, "canExport": true.
"canCapture" is true for an Online or Hybrid meeting in InProgress and false for an InPerson one.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
An Online meeting in InProgress with a Chair, a Secretary and a Member on its participant list. One Online and one InPerson meeting.

cases.description: Verify GET /api/meetings/{meetingId}/speech-clips returns only a Guest's own sentences.
procedure: Join as a Guest through the guest link and keep the guest token.
Send GET /api/meetings/{meetingId}/speech-clips with Authorization: Bearer <guestToken>.
expected: HTTP 200 OK.
Only the Guest's sentences are listed; "canEdit", "canExclude" and "canExport" are false, "canDelete" is true and "leak" is null.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
An Online meeting in InProgress with a Chair, a Secretary and a Member on its participant list. A Guest admitted who has spoken, and sentences of members.

cases.description: Verify PUT /api/meetings/{meetingId}/speech-clips/{clientClipId} transcribes and stores a member's sentence under their own name.
procedure: Sign in as a Member of the meeting (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.

Send PUT /api/meetings/{meetingId}/speech-clips/{clientClipId}?startedAt=<ISO time>&durationMs=2400
   Headers: Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>; Content-Type: audio/wav
   Body: a WAV of speech
expected: HTTP 200 OK.
Body: { "code": "MSG318", "message": "Đã ghi câu nói.", "clip": { "id", "speakerId": <the caller>, "text", "startedAt", "durationMs" } }.
The sentence has audio stored for listening again and is listed by GET /api/meetings/{meetingId}/speech-clips.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
An Online meeting in InProgress with a Chair, a Secretary and a Member on its participant list. The speech worker running; clientClipId is a new GUID.

cases.description: Verify PUT /api/meetings/{meetingId}/speech-clips/{clientClipId} refuses a body that is not wav, webm or ogg audio.

   Body: a PDF
expected: HTTP 400 Bad Request.
Body: { "code": "MSG319", "message": "Câu nói phải gửi dạng âm thanh wav, webm hoặc ogg." }.
The speech worker is not called.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
An Online meeting in InProgress with a Chair, a Secretary and a Member on its participant list.

cases.description: Verify PUT /api/meetings/{meetingId}/speech-clips/{clientClipId} refuses an audio body over 3 MB.

cases.description: Verify PUT /api/meetings/{meetingId}/speech-clips/{clientClipId} still accepts a sentence kept on the device up to 7 days after the meeting ended and refuses it later.
procedure: Sign in as a Member of the meeting (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.

Send PUT /api/meetings/{meetingId}/speech-clips/{clientClipId}?startedAt=<ISO time>&durationMs=2400
   Headers: Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>; Content-Type: audio/wav
   Body: a sentence spoken during the meeting, sent 6 days 23 hours after it ended
Repeat 7 days and 1 hour after it ended.
expected: The first call answers HTTP 200 MSG318 and the sentence ends no later than the meeting's end time.
The second call answers HTTP 409 with "code": "MSG320".
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
An Online meeting in Ended with a Chair, a Secretary and a Member on its participant list. Clock control by the QA lead.

cases.description: Verify PUT /api/meetings/{meetingId}/speech-clips/{clientClipId} refuses a Guest who has not confirmed the recording notice.
procedure: Use a Guest token whose session has no call.guest_admitted record (recording notice never acknowledged).

Send PUT /api/meetings/{meetingId}/speech-clips/{clientClipId}?startedAt=<ISO time>&durationMs=2400

expected: HTTP 400 Bad Request.
Body: { "code": "MSG380", "message": "Vui lòng xác nhận đã đọc thông báo ghi âm trước khi vào phòng họp." }.
Nothing is stored.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
An Online meeting in InProgress with a Chair, a Secretary and a Member on its participant list. A Guest invitation that was never admitted with the notice confirmed.

expected: HTTP 404 Not Found with no body in all three calls.
